topic.source_contract: runoff hierarchy, rainfall and climate inputs, hydraulic design, water quality, exceedance, land and outfall rights, adoption, construction, commissioning and maintenance evidence

scope_guards: A drainage strategy is not treated as an approved detailed design.
Modelled storage is not treated as constructed available volume.
An adoption discussion is not treated as an executed adoption agreement.
A planning condition is not treated as discharged.
An outfall indication is not treated as a legal discharge right.
A completed asset is not treated as commissioned hydraulic performance.
A maintenance schedule is not treated as funded long-term maintenance.
No score or promotion is written without exact design, rights, approval, construction, adoption and performance evidence.
